title: Multi-task 3D U-Net segments hematoma and edema and predicts expansion on non-contrast CT
summary: A multi-task model with a 3D U-Net backbone was trained on baseline non-contrast CT from 981 patients with spontaneous intracerebral hemorrhage at four centres (429 training, 183 internal validation, 369 external test). It reached a mean Dice of 0.909 for hematoma and 0.686 for perihematomal edema, and an AUC of 0.888 for hematoma expansion (sensitivity 0.949, specificity 0.710). Retrospective development study with moderate specificity.
ai_technology: Multi-task 3D U-Net on dual-window non-contrast CT for segmentation and expansion prediction

evidence.tested: External testing in 369 cases from a multicentre retrospective cohort of 981 patients.
